segments.name: Home water solutions
segments.description: Designs, develops, manufactures and markets home water solution products, sold mainly to customers in the PRC.
segments.evidence: The Group operates as one operating and reportable segment and its sole business activity consists of the design, development, manufacturing and marketing of Home water solution businesses products.

revenueModel.text: Customers, mainly in the PRC, pay for home water solution products and related services, recognised when control of the goods passes to them.
revenueModel.evidence: The Group provides Home water solution businesses products mainly to its customers in the PRC and manages its business activities on a consolidated basis.

changes.text: In 2024 the Group agreed to dispose of Foshan Viomi and its subsidiaries, which were treated as discontinued operations.
changes.evidence: On July 19, 2024, the Group entered into definitive agreements with Mr. Chen, and an entity controlled by Mr. Chen (Refer to Note 1).
